Kaplan-Meier Summary Table at Regular Times

Source: R/km_table.R
km_table.Rd

Reports the Kaplan-Meier estimate of each treatment arm at the times 0, interval, 2 * interval, ... up to the largest observed time of the arm, with the number at risk, the numbers of events and censored observations since the previous time, the standard error (Greenwood) and the pointwise confidence interval of survival::survfit().

Usage

km_table(
  data,
  interval,
  conf_level = 0.95,
  conf_type = c("log", "log-log", "plain")
)

Arguments

data

Data frame returned by processing_dataset.

interval

Positive number, the spacing of the reporting times in the time unit of the data.

conf_level

Confidence level, a single number in (0, 1). The default is 0.95.

conf_type

Transformation for the pointwise confidence intervals: "log" (the default of survival::survfit()), "log-log" or "plain".

Value

A data frame with the columns ARM, time, n_risk (number with an observed time at or after time), n_event and n_censor (numbers of events and censored observations after the previous reporting time and up to time), surv (Kaplan-Meier estimate), se (standard error of surv), lcl and ucl (confidence limits; both equal to 1 while surv is 1).

Examples

raw <- generate_dummy_survival_data(
  arm = c("Control", "Treatment"), n = c(100, 100),
  hazards = log(2) / c(12, 18), dropout_per_year = 0.1, seed = 123
)
dat <- processing_dataset(raw, column_arm = "ARM",
                          column_survtime = "SURVTIME",
                          column_cnsr = "CNSR")
km_table(dat, interval = 6)
